whyBlindfoldChess.title: Why Blindfold Chess?
whyBlindfoldChess.intro: Blindfold Chess is the best way to develop visualization skills in chess.
whyBlindfoldChess.explanation: Strong players can "see" several moves ahead in their minds. This ability is not innate, but a skill acquired through deliberate practice.
whyBlindfoldChess.abilitiesIntro: Blindfold Chess directly trains the following abilities:
whyBlindfoldChess.ability1: Ability to imagine piece positions without looking at the board
whyBlindfoldChess.ability2: Ability to calculate variations in your head
whyBlindfoldChess.ability3: Ability to recognize patterns and structures
whyBlindfoldChess.conclusion: As a result, your overall chess strength will improve.

intro.title: What is Board Symmetry?
intro.description: Training board symmetry helps you instantly find corresponding squares. There are three main types of symmetry on the chessboard.

horizontal.title: Vertical Symmetry (File)
horizontal.description: Squares symmetric with respect to the central vertical line (between d and e files). Example: a1 ↔ h1, c3 ↔ f3.

vertical.title: Horizontal Symmetry (Rank)
vertical.description: Squares symmetric with respect to the central horizontal line (between 4th and 5th ranks). Example: a1 ↔ a8, h2 ↔ h7.

point.title: Point Symmetry (Center)
point.description: Squares symmetric with respect to the center of the board (rotated 180 degrees). Example: a1 ↔ h8, c3 ↔ f6.

diagonal.title: What is a Diagonal?
diagonal.description:
A diagonal runs in the a1-h8 direction.
All squares where (file - rank) is constant belong to the same diagonal.
The green squares show the diagonal passing through d4.

antiDiagonal.title: What is an Anti-diagonal?
antiDiagonal.description:
An anti-diagonal runs in the h1-a8 direction.
All squares where (file + rank) is constant belong to the same anti-diagonal.
The blue squares show the anti-diagonal passing through d4.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Our privacy policy and how we handle your personal information
privacy.introduction: Blindfold Chess ("the Site") respects user privacy and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how the Site collects, uses, and protects information.
privacy.cookiesDescription: The Site uses cookies to improve service quality and deliver advertisements. Cookies are small text files stored on your device by websites. While you can disable cookies, some features may not function properly.
privacy.analyticsDescription: The Site uses Google Analytics to understand site usage and improve services. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect the following information:
privacy.analyticsItem1: Access statistics such as visitor count and page views
privacy.analyticsItem2: Behavior patterns and time spent on the site
privacy.analyticsPrivacyPolicy: Data collected by Google Analytics is managed according to Google's Privacy Policy. For details, please see:
privacy.adsenseDescription: The Site uses Google AdSense as an advertising service. Google AdSense uses cookies to deliver personalized ads based on user interests. The following information may be used:
privacy.adsenseItem1: Past access information to this site and other sites
privacy.adsenseItem2: IP address (does not contain personally identifiable information)
privacy.adsenseOptOut: If you do not want personalized ads delivered, you can change your settings at:

privacy.partnerSitesLink: How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services
privacy.localStorageDescription: The Site uses browser local storage for the following purposes:
privacy.localStorageItem1: Saving game progress and user settings
privacy.localStorageNote: This information is stored only on your device and is not transmitted to external servers. You can delete this information at any time by clearing your browser cache.
privacy.personalDataDescription: The Site does not provide user registration. While a contact form is available, information submitted through it is used solely for responding to inquiries and is not used for any other purpose. The Site does not otherwise directly collect personally identifiable information such as names, email addresses, or phone numbers.
privacy.thirdPartyLinksDescription: The Site may contain links to external sites. The Site is not responsible for the privacy policies of these external sites. When visiting external sites, please review their respective privacy policies.
privacy.childrenPrivacyDescription: The Site does not intentionally collect personal information from children under 13 years of age. Parents should appropriately supervise their children's internet use.
privacy.yourRightsDescription: You have the following rights regarding your data:
privacy.yourRightsItem1: Right of access — You have the right to know what data is being collected about you
privacy.yourRightsItem2: Right to deletion — You have the right to request the deletion of your data

privacy.yourRightsItem4: To exercise these rights, please contact us through the contact form
privacy.cookieDetailsDescription: The following types of cookies are used on the Site:
